title: Diffusion models in 60 seconds
caption: Diffusion models in 60 seconds: how image generators turn pure noise into a picture. #ai #stablediffusion #genai

scenes.title: Diffusion
scenes.say: Every AI image starts as pure static. Really.
Take a photo and add a little noise. Then more. Keep going, and eventually it's pure static.
A diffusion model learns to undo that.

items.title: Noise
items.say: Training adds noise to millions of real images.

items.title: Denoise
items.say: The model learns to predict the noise, so it can be removed.

items.title: Guide
items.say: And a text caption steers what the picture becomes.

scenes.code:
start:  pure random noise
step 1: slightly less noise
step 2: shapes appear
...
step 30: "a fox in snow"
scenes.say: To generate, start from pure noise, and denoise step by step, guided by your prompt.
That's diffusion. Every image starts as static.
